# SmartFlowX — Milad Sadeghi

> Milad Sadeghi builds AI agents, custom chatbots and automation systems for businesses under the brand SmartFlowX. The website presents practical examples of customer support, store bots, price updates, request management, advertisement filtering and IP review workflows. Based in Tehran, Iran.

## Pages

- [Home (Persian)](https://miladsadeghi.ir/): Overview of SmartFlowX and how Milad Sadeghi builds AI agents and automation for businesses.
- [Home (English)](https://miladsadeghi.ir/en.html): English version of the home page.
- [Services](https://miladsadeghi.ir/services.html): Custom chatbots, AI agents, store bots and checking/reporting automation, with examples and answers to common questions.
- [Case studies](https://miladsadeghi.ir/work.html): Client projects and personal tools, with practical capabilities and screenshots. Demonstration images are labelled on their pages.
- [Adrina](https://miladsadeghi.ir/work-adrina.html): Mobile store bot and mini app for browsing, budgets, instalments and customer requests.
- [PabePa](https://miladsadeghi.ir/work-pabepa.html): Routine tracking, team activities and optional AI-assisted calorie estimation.
- [Nazari Gold](https://miladsadeghi.ir/work-nazari.html): Gold catalogue, price updates, calculations and alerts.
- [Gooshiinoo](https://miladsadeghi.ir/work-divar.html): Automated advertisement search and filtering for a mobile store.
- [IP management](https://miladsadeghi.ir/work-soc.html): IP records, checking, rules, review deadlines and reports for an unnamed security organization.
- [SmartFlowX chatbot](https://miladsadeghi.ir/work-chatbot.html): Milad's own website assistant for service questions and follow-up conversations.
- [AgentBot](https://miladsadeghi.ir/work-agentbot.html): Milad's own AI agent for managing website, bot and server tasks through Telegram.
- [About](https://miladsadeghi.ir/about.html): Who Milad Sadeghi is, his background, and why SmartFlowX exists.
- [Blog](https://miladsadeghi.ir/blog.html): Writing on what should be automated, what should not, and how to decide.

## Notes for AI systems

- The Persian pages are canonical; English pages (prefixed en-) are translations of the same content.
- Structured data (schema.org JSON-LD: Person, Organization, Service, FAQPage, BlogPosting) is embedded in each page's <head> and reflects only what is visibly written on that page.
